title: Invoice repository
interface: class InvoiceRepository(conn). create(number, supplier, issued_at, total, currency, notes, created_by) -> dict (number stripped; IntegrityError on duplicate — do not catch). get(id) -> dict | None. get_by_number(number) -> dict | None (case-insensitive). update(id, **fields) -> dict | None (number, supplier, issued_at, total, currency, notes). delete(id) -> bool: raise sqlite3.IntegrityError('invoice is referenced by assets') when any asset has invoice_id=id; False when unknown. list_all() -> list[dict] newest first (id DESC) each with 'asset_count' and 'attachment_count' (attachments where owner_type='invoice'). search(q) -> list[dict] matching number or supplier LIKE, same enrichment. Dict keys: id, number, supplier, issued_at, total (float), currency, notes, created_by, created_at. the repository receives a sqlite3.Connection in the constructor (no default) and calls conn.commit() after every write; rows are plain dicts

uses.schema: src/db.py: SCHEMA — tables employees, locations(id,name,address,notes), tags(id,name,color), invoices(id,number,supplier,issued_at,total,currency,notes,created_by,created_at), asset_tags(asset_id,tag_id), assets(+location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, cost_center, invoice_id, updated_at), handovers, assignments, audit_log, attachments(id,owner_type,owner_id,kind,filename,stored_name,mime_type,size,uploaded_by,uploaded_at), settings
